sentences.zh: 出見檜，一揖而去，檜亦憾之。

translations.literal: Going out he saw Hui, bowed once, and left. Hui also resented this.
translations.idiomatic: Going out he saw Hui, bowed once, and left—and Hui resented it.

sentences.zh: 鼎既去，檜獨專國，決意議和。

translations.literal: After Ding departed, Hui alone monopolized the state and resolved to negotiate peace.
translations.idiomatic: After Ding departed, Hui alone monopolized the state and resolved to negotiate peace.

sentences.zh: 中朝賢士，以議論不合，相繼而去。

translations.literal: Worthy men at court, disagreeing in deliberation, departed in succession.
translations.idiomatic: Worthy men at court, disagreeing with his policies, departed in succession.

sentences.zh: 於是，中書舍人呂本中、禮部侍郎張九成皆不附和議，檜諭之使優遊委曲，九成曰：「未有枉己而能正人者。」

translations.literal: Thereupon Drafting Official Lü Benzhong and Vice Minister of Rites Zhang Jiucheng both did not endorse the peace talks. Hui instructed them to be flexible and accommodating. Jiucheng said: "No one who bends himself can set others straight."
translations.idiomatic: Drafting Official Lü Benzhong and Vice Minister of Rites Zhang Jiucheng both refused to endorse the peace talks; Hui instructed them to be flexible and accommodating, but Jiucheng said, "No one who bends himself can set others straight."

sentences.zh: 檜深憾之。

translations.literal: Hui deeply resented this.
translations.idiomatic: Hui deeply resented this.

sentences.zh: 殿中侍御史張戒上疏乞留趙鼎，又陳十三事論和議之非，忤檜。

translations.literal: Palace Censor Zhang Jie submitted a memorial asking to retain Zhao Ding and also set forth thirteen points arguing against peace talks, offending Hui.
translations.idiomatic: Palace Censor Zhang Jie submitted a memorial asking to retain Zhao Ding and set forth thirteen points against peace talks, offending Hui.

sentences.zh: 王庶與檜尤不合，自淮西入樞庭，始終言和議非是，疏凡七上，且謂檜曰：「而忘東都欲存趙氏時，何遺此敵邪？」

translations.literal: Wang Shu was especially at odds with Hui. From Huaixi he entered the Bureau of Military Affairs and from first to last argued that peace talks were wrong, submitting seven memorials in all, and said to Hui: "Have you forgotten when at the Eastern Capital you wished to preserve the Zhao house—why have you abandoned this enemy?"
translations.idiomatic: Wang Shu was especially at odds with Hui; from Huaixi he entered the Bureau of Military Affairs and consistently argued that peace talks were wrong, submitting seven memorials in all, and said to Hui, "Have you forgotten when at the Eastern Capital you wished to preserve the Zhao house—why have you abandoned this enemy?"

sentences.zh: 檜方挾金人自重，尤恨庶言，故出之。

translations.literal: Hui was then using the Jurchens to bolster his own weight and especially hated Shu's words, and therefore had him removed.
translations.idiomatic: Hui was then using the Jurchens to bolster his own position and especially hated Shu's words, and therefore had him removed.

sentences.zh: 樞密院編修官胡銓上疏，願斬檜與王倫以謝天下。

translations.literal: Compiler in the Bureau of Military Affairs Hu Quan submitted a memorial wishing to execute Hui and Wang Lun to appease the realm.
translations.idiomatic: Compiler in the Bureau of Military Affairs Hu Quan submitted a memorial calling for the execution of Hui and Wang Lun to appease the realm.

sentences.zh: 於是上下洶洶。

translations.literal: Thereupon both above and below were in uproar.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon both court and country were in uproar.

sentences.zh: 檜謬為解救，卒械送銓貶昭州。

translations.literal: Hui falsely interceded on his behalf, but in the end had Quan shackled and sent into exile at Chaozhou.
translations.idiomatic: Hui feigned intercession on his behalf, but in the end had Quan shackled and exiled to Chaozhou.

sentences.zh: 陳剛中以啟賀銓，檜大怒，送剛中吏部，差知贛州安遠縣。

translations.literal: Chen Gangzhong sent a letter congratulating Quan. Hui was greatly angered and sent Gangzhong to the Ministry of Personnel, assigning him as magistrate of Anyuan County in Ganzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Gangzhong sent a letter congratulating Quan; Hui was greatly angered and sent Gangzhong to the Ministry of Personnel, assigning him as magistrate of Anyuan County in Ganzhou.

sentences.zh: 贛有十二邑，安遠濱嶺，地惡瘴深，諺曰：「龍南、安遠，一去不轉。」

translations.literal: Ganzhou had twelve districts. Anyuan bordered the mountains; the land was harsh and miasma deep. A proverb said: "Longnan and Anyuan—once you go, you do not return."
translations.idiomatic: Ganzhou had twelve districts; Anyuan bordered the mountains, the land was harsh and miasma deep, and a proverb said, "Longnan and Anyuan—once you go, you do not return."

sentences.zh: 言必死也。

translations.literal: It meant certain death.
translations.idiomatic: It meant certain death.

sentences.zh: 剛中果死。

translations.literal: Gangzhong indeed died.
translations.idiomatic: Gangzhong indeed died.

sentences.zh: 尋以銓事戒諭中外。

translations.literal: Soon, on account of the Quan affair, an admonition was issued inside and outside the court.
translations.idiomatic: Soon, on account of the Quan affair, an admonition was issued throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 既而校書郎許忻、樞密院編修官趙雍同日上疏，猶祖銓意，力排和議。

translations.literal: Before long Proofreader Xu Xin and Compiler in the Bureau of Military Affairs Zhao Yong submitted memorials on the same day, still following Quan's intent and forcefully opposing peace talks.
translations.idiomatic: Before long Proofreader Xu Xin and Compiler Zhao Yong submitted memorials on the same day, still following Quan's line and forcefully opposing peace talks.

sentences.zh: 雍又欲正南北兄弟之名，檜亦不能罪。

translations.literal: Yong also wished to rectify the names of northern and southern brothers. Hui could not punish him for it.
translations.idiomatic: Yong also wished to rectify the names of northern and southern brothers, and Hui could not punish him for it.

sentences.zh: 曾開見檜，言今日當論存亡，不當論安危。

translations.literal: Zeng Kai saw Hui and said that today one should speak of survival and extinction, not of safety and danger.
translations.idiomatic: Zeng Kai saw Hui and said that today one should speak of survival and extinction, not of safety and danger.

sentences.zh: 檜駭愕，遂出之。

translations.literal: Hui was startled and alarmed, and had him removed.
translations.idiomatic: Hui was startled and had him removed.

sentences.zh: 司勳員外郎朱松、館職胡珵、張擴、淩景夏、常明、範如圭同上一疏言：「金人以和之一字得志於我者十有二年，以覆我王室，以弛我邊備，以竭我國力，以懈緩我不共戴天之仇，以絕望我中國謳吟思漢之赤子，以詔諭江南為名，要陛下以稽首之禮。

translations.literal: Gentleman of the Bureau of Merit Zhu Song, and Academicians Hu Cheng, Zhang Kuo, Ling Jingxia, Chang Ming, and Fan Rugui jointly submitted a memorial saying: "For twelve years the Jurchens have had their way with us through the single word 'peace'—to overthrow our royal house, to relax our frontier defenses, to exhaust our national strength, to slacken our hatred of an enemy with whom we cannot share the sky, to despair the common people of China who sing and sigh for Han, and under the name of 'imperial edict instructing Jiangnan' to demand that Your Majesty perform the kowtow.
translations.idiomatic: Gentleman of the Bureau of Merit Zhu Song and Academicians Hu Cheng, Zhang Kuo, Ling Jingxia, Chang Ming, and Fan Rugui jointly submitted a memorial saying, "For twelve years the Jurchens have had their way with us through the single word 'peace'—to overthrow our royal house, relax our frontier defenses, exhaust our national strength, slacken our hatred of an enemy with whom we cannot share the sky, despair the common people of China who sing and sigh for Han, and under the name of 'imperial edict instructing Jiangnan' demand that Your Majesty perform the kowtow.

sentences.zh: 自公卿大夫至六軍萬姓，莫不扼腕憤怒，豈肯聽陛下北面為仇敵之臣哉！

translations.literal: From high ministers and grandees down to the myriad people of the six armies, none fail to clench their fists in rage—how could they consent to hear Your Majesty face north and become a subject of the enemy!
translations.idiomatic: From high ministers and grandees down to the myriad people of the six armies, none fail to clench their fists in rage—how could they consent to see Your Majesty face north and become a subject of the enemy!

sentences.zh: 天下將有仗大義，問相公之罪者。」

translations.literal: Throughout the realm there will be those who, upholding great righteousness, will call the chief minister to account for his crimes."
translations.idiomatic: Throughout the realm there will be those who, upholding great righteousness, will call the chief minister to account."

sentences.zh: 後數日，權吏部尚書張燾、吏部侍郎晏敦復、魏矼、戶部侍郎李彌遜、梁汝嘉、給事中樓炤、中書舍人蘇符、工部侍郎蕭振、起居舍人薛徽言同班入奏，極言屈己之禮非是。

translations.literal: Several days later Acting Minister of Personnel Zhang Tao, Vice Ministers of Personnel Yan Dunfu and Wei Kang, Vice Minister of Revenue Li Mixun and Liang Rujia, Drafting Reviewer Lou Zhao, Drafting Official Su Fu, Vice Minister of Works Xiao Zhen, and Diarist Xue Huiyan entered together to memorialize, speaking at length that the rites of self-humiliation were wrong.
translations.idiomatic: Several days later Acting Minister of Personnel Zhang Tao, Vice Ministers Yan Dunfu and Wei Kang, Vice Minister of Revenue Li Mixun and Liang Rujia, Drafting Reviewer Lou Zhao, Drafting Official Su Fu, Vice Minister of Works Xiao Zhen, and Diarist Xue Huiyan entered together to memorialize, arguing at length that the rites of self-humiliation were wrong.

sentences.zh: 新除禮部侍郎尹焞獨上疏，且移書切責檜，檜始大怒，焞于是固辭新命不拜。

translations.literal: The newly appointed Vice Minister of Rites Yin Hun alone submitted a memorial and also sent a letter sharply rebuking Hui. Hui was finally greatly angered, and Hun therefore firmly declined the new appointment and did not accept it.
translations.idiomatic: The newly appointed Vice Minister of Rites Yin Hun alone submitted a memorial and sent a letter sharply rebuking Hui; Hui was finally greatly angered, and Hun firmly declined the new appointment.

sentences.zh: 奉禮郎馮時行召對，言和議不可信，至引漢高祖分羹事為喻。

translations.literal: Ceremonial Gentleman Feng Shixing was summoned for an audience and said peace talks could not be trusted, even citing the affair of Emperor Gaozu of Han dividing the broth as a comparison.
translations.idiomatic: Ceremonial Gentleman Feng Shixing was summoned for an audience and said peace talks could not be trusted, even citing Emperor Gaozu of Han dividing the broth as a comparison.

sentences.zh: 帝曰：「朕不忍聞。」

translations.literal: The emperor said: "I cannot bear to hear this."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said, "I cannot bear to hear this."

sentences.zh: 顰蹙而起。

translations.literal: He frowned and rose.
translations.idiomatic: He frowned and rose.

sentences.zh: 檜乃謫時行知萬州，尋亦抵罪。

translations.literal: Hui then demoted Shixing to serve as Prefect of Wanzhou, and soon he was also punished for an offense.
translations.idiomatic: Hui then demoted Shixing to serve as Prefect of Wanzhou, and soon he was also punished for an offense.

sentences.zh: 中書舍人勾龍如淵抗言於檜曰：「邪說橫起，胡不擇台官擊去之。」

translations.literal: Drafting Official Goulong Ruyuan spoke boldly to Hui: "Heretical talk rises on every side—why not select censorate officials to strike them down?"
translations.idiomatic: Drafting Official Goulong Ruyuan spoke boldly to Hui, "Heretical talk rises on every side—why not select censorate officials to strike it down?"

sentences.zh: 檜遂奏如淵為御史中丞，首劾銓。

translations.literal: Hui then memorialized to appoint Ruyuan as Censor-in-Chief, who first impeached Quan.
translations.idiomatic: Hui then memorialized to appoint Ruyuan as Censor-in-Chief, who first impeached Quan.

sentences.zh: 金使張通古、蕭哲以詔諭江南為名，檜猶恐物論咎己，與哲等議，改江南為宋，詔諭為國信。

translations.literal: Jin envoys Zhang Tonggu and Xiao Zhe came under the name of 'imperial edict instructing Jiangnan.' Hui still feared public criticism would blame him and discussed with Zhe and the others changing Jiangnan to Song and 'imperial edict instructing' to 'imperial letter of credence.'
translations.idiomatic: Jin envoys Zhang Tonggu and Xiao Zhe came under the name of 'imperial edict instructing Jiangnan'; Hui still feared public blame and discussed with Zhe and the others changing Jiangnan to Song and 'imperial edict instructing' to 'imperial letter of credence.'

sentences.zh: 京、淮宣撫處置使韓世忠凡四上疏力諫，有「金以劉豫相待」之語，且言兵勢重處，願以身當之，不許。

translations.literal: Pacification Commissioner of Jing and Huai Han Shizhong submitted four memorials in all forcefully remonstrating, with words such as 'Jin treats us as it treated Liu Yu,' and also said that where military strength was concentrated he wished to take it upon himself—this was not permitted.
translations.idiomatic: Pacification Commissioner of Jing and Huai Han Shizhong submitted four memorials forcefully remonstrating, with words such as 'Jin treats us as it treated Liu Yu,' and offered to take personal command where military strength was concentrated—this was refused.

sentences.zh: 哲等既至泗州，要所過州縣迎以臣禮，至臨安日，欲帝待以客禮，世忠益憤，再疏言：「金以詔諭為名，暗致陛下歸順之義，此主辱臣死之時，願效死戰以決勝敗。

translations.literal: After Zhe and the others reached Sizhou, they demanded that the prefectures and counties they passed through receive them with the rites due a subject. On the day they reached Lin'an they wanted the emperor to treat them with the rites due a guest. Shizhong grew more indignant and submitted another memorial saying: "Jin uses 'imperial edict instructing' as a name to covertly impose upon Your Majesty the meaning of submission. This is the time when the ruler is shamed and ministers must die—I wish to fight to the death to decide victory and defeat.
translations.idiomatic: After Zhe and the others reached Sizhou, they demanded that the prefectures and counties they passed through receive them with the rites due a subject; on reaching Lin'an they wanted the emperor to treat them with the rites due a guest. Shizhong grew more indignant and submitted another memorial: "Jin uses 'imperial edict instructing' to covertly impose submission upon Your Majesty—this is the time when the ruler is shamed and ministers must die; I wish to fight to the death to decide victory and defeat.

sentences.zh: 若其不克，委曲從之未晚。」

translations.literal: If we cannot prevail, to yield tactfully will not yet be too late."
translations.idiomatic: If we cannot prevail, yielding tactfully will not yet be too late."

sentences.zh: 亦不許。

translations.literal: This too was not permitted.
translations.idiomatic: This too was refused.

sentences.zh: 哲等既入境，接伴使範同再拜問金主起居，軍民見者，往往流涕。

translations.literal: After Zhe and the others entered the border, Escort Commissioner Fan Tong bowed twice and inquired after the Jin ruler's health. Soldiers and civilians who saw it often wept.
translations.idiomatic: After Zhe and the others entered the border, Escort Commissioner Fan Tong bowed twice and inquired after the Jin ruler's health—soldiers and civilians who saw it often wept.

sentences.zh: 過平江，守臣向子諲不拜，乞致仕。

translations.literal: Passing Pingjiang, the defending official Xiang Ziyin did not bow and requested retirement.
translations.idiomatic: Passing Pingjiang, the defending official Xiang Ziyin refused to bow and requested retirement.

sentences.zh: 哲等至淮安，言先歸河南地，且冊上為帝，徐議餘事。

translations.literal: Zhe and the others reached Huai'an and said they would first return the lands of Henan and also enfeoff the emperor, discussing other matters afterward.
translations.idiomatic: Zhe and the others reached Huai'an and said they would first return the lands of Henan and enfeoff the emperor, discussing other matters afterward.

sentences.zh: 檜至是欲上行屈己之禮，帝曰：「朕嗣守太祖、太宗基業，豈可受金人封冊。」

translations.literal: By this time Hui wished the emperor to perform the rites of self-humiliation. The emperor said: "I succeed in guarding the foundations of Taizu and Taizong—how can I accept enfeoffment from the Jurchens?"
translations.idiomatic: By this time Hui wished the emperor to perform the rites of self-humiliation; the emperor said, "I succeed in guarding the foundations of Taizu and Taizong—how can I accept enfeoffment from the Jurchens?"

sentences.zh: 會三衙帥楊沂中、解潛、韓世良相率見檜曰：「軍民洶洶，若之何？」

translations.literal: The three commanders of the palace armies—Yang Yizhong, Xie Qian, and Han Shiliang—came together to see Hui and said: "Soldiers and civilians are in uproar—what is to be done?"
translations.idiomatic: The three commanders of the palace armies—Yang Yizhong, Xie Qian, and Han Shiliang—came together to see Hui and said, "Soldiers and civilians are in uproar—what is to be done?"

sentences.zh: 退，又白之台諫。

translations.literal: On withdrawing they also reported it to the censors and remonstrators.
translations.idiomatic: On withdrawing they also reported it to the censors and remonstrators.

sentences.zh: 於是勾龍如淵、李誼數見檜議國書事，如淵謂得其書納之禁中，則禮不行而事定。

translations.literal: Thereupon Goulong Ruyuan and Li Yi repeatedly saw Hui to discuss the matter of the state letter. Ruyuan said that if the letter were obtained and placed within the palace, the rites would not be performed and the affair would be settled.
translations.idiomatic: Goulong Ruyuan and Li Yi repeatedly saw Hui to discuss the state letter; Ruyuan said that if the letter were obtained and placed within the palace, the rites would not be performed and the affair would be settled.

sentences.zh: 給事中樓炤亦舉「諒陰三年不言」事以告檜，於是定檜攝塚宰受書之議。

translations.literal: Drafting Reviewer Lou Zhao also cited the matter of 'three years of mourning without speaking' to inform Hui. Thereupon the plan was settled for Hui to act as chief mourner and receive the letter.
translations.idiomatic: Drafting Reviewer Lou Zhao also cited the precedent of 'three years of mourning without speaking' to inform Hui; thereupon the plan was settled for Hui to act as chief mourner and receive the letter.

sentences.zh: 帝亦切責王倫，倫諭金使，金使亦懼而從。

translations.literal: The emperor also sharply rebuked Wang Lun. Lun instructed the Jin envoys, and the Jin envoys also feared and complied.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor also sharply rebuked Wang Lun; Lun instructed the Jin envoys, and they too feared and complied.

sentences.zh: 帝命檜即館中見哲等受其書。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered Hui to see Zhe and the others at the guest house and receive their letter.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered Hui to see Zhe and the others at the guest house and receive their letter.

sentences.zh: 金使欲百官備禮，檜使省吏朝服導從，以書納禁中。

translations.literal: The Jin envoys wanted all officials to prepare the full rites. Hui had provincial clerks in court dress lead the procession and placed the letter within the palace.
translations.idiomatic: The Jin envoys wanted all officials to prepare the full rites; Hui had provincial clerks in court dress lead the procession and placed the letter within the palace.

sentences.zh: 先一日，詔金使來，將盡割河南、陝西故地，又許還梓宮及母兄親族，初無需索。

translations.literal: The day before, an edict announced the coming of the Jin envoys: the former lands of Henan and Shaanxi would be fully ceded back, and the return of the imperial coffin and the emperor's mother, brothers, and kin was also promised, with no initial demands.
translations.idiomatic: The day before, an edict announced the coming of the Jin envoys: the former lands of Henan and Shaanxi would be fully restored, the return of the imperial coffin and the emperor's mother, brothers, and kin was promised, with no initial demands.

sentences.zh: 以參知政事李光素有時望，俾押和議榜以鎮浮言。

translations.literal: Because Vice Director Li Guang had long enjoyed public esteem, he was made to endorse the peace proclamation to suppress loose talk.
translations.idiomatic: Because Vice Director Li Guang had long enjoyed public esteem, he was made to endorse the peace proclamation to suppress loose talk.

sentences.zh: 又降禦劄賜三大將。

translations.literal: Imperial notes were also issued to the three great generals.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial notes were also issued to the three great generals.

sentences.zh: 九年，金人歸河南、陝西故地，以王倫簽書樞密院事，充迎奉梓宮、奉還兩宮、交割地界使，藍公佐副之。

translations.literal: In the ninth year the Jurchens returned the former lands of Henan and Shaanxi. Wang Lun was appointed Deputy Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs and served as envoy to receive the imperial coffin, return the two palaces, and hand over territorial boundaries, with Lan Gongzuo as deputy.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year the Jurchens returned the former lands of Henan and Shaanxi; Wang Lun was appointed Deputy Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs and envoy to receive the imperial coffin, return the two palaces, and hand over territorial boundaries, with Lan Gongzuo as deputy.

sentences.zh: 判大宗正事士㒟、兵部侍郎張燾朝八陵。

translations.literal: Director of the Imperial Clan Affairs Shi Yi and Vice Minister of War Zhang Tao paid court at the eight imperial tombs.
translations.idiomatic: Director of Imperial Clan Affairs Shi Yi and Vice Minister of War Zhang Tao paid court at the eight imperial tombs.

sentences.zh: 帝謂宰執曰：「河南新復，宜命守臣專撫遺民，勸農桑，各因其地以食，因其人以守，不可移東南之財，虛內以事外。」

translations.literal: The emperor said to the chief ministers: "Henan is newly recovered. Defending officials should be ordered to focus on comforting the remaining people, encouraging agriculture and sericulture, feeding each region according to its land and defending each region according to its people. The wealth of the southeast must not be shifted to empty the interior for the sake of the exterior."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor told the chief ministers, "Henan is newly recovered—defending officials should focus on comforting the remaining people, encouraging agriculture and sericulture, feeding each region according to its land and defending each region according to its people; the wealth of the southeast must not be shifted to empty the interior for the sake of the exterior."

sentences.zh: 帝雖聽檜和而實疑金詐，未嘗弛備也。

translations.literal: Although the emperor listened to Hui on peace, he in fact suspected Jin deceit and never relaxed preparations.
translations.idiomatic: Although the emperor listened to Hui on peace, he in fact suspected Jin deceit and never relaxed preparations.

sentences.zh: 時張浚在永州，馳奏，力言以石晉、劉豫為戒，復遺書孫近，以「帝秦之禍，發遲而大」。

translations.literal: At the time Zhang Jun was at Yongzhou. He sent urgent memorials forcefully citing the Later Jin and Liu Yu as warnings, and also sent a letter to Sun Jin with the words: "The calamity of submitting to Qin comes slowly but grows great."
translations.idiomatic: At the time Zhang Jun was at Yongzhou; he sent urgent memorials citing the Later Jin and Liu Yu as warnings, and sent a letter to Sun Jin with the words, "The calamity of submitting to Qin comes slowly but grows great."

sentences.zh: 徐俯守上饒，連南夫帥廣東，岳飛宣撫淮西，皆因賀表寓諷。

translations.literal: Xu Fu guarded Shangrao, Lian Nanfu commanded Guangdong, and Yue Fei pacified Huaixi—all conveyed satire in their congratulatory memorials.
translations.idiomatic: Xu Fu guarded Shangrao, Lian Nanfu commanded Guangdong, and Yue Fei pacified Huaixi—all conveyed satire in their congratulatory memorials.

sentences.zh: 俯曰：「禍福倚伏，情偽多端。」

translations.literal: Fu said: "Fortune and misfortune lean upon each other; truth and falsehood take many forms."
translations.idiomatic: Fu said, "Fortune and misfortune lean upon each other; truth and falsehood take many forms."

sentences.zh: 南夫曰：「不信亦信，其然豈然？

translations.literal: Nanfu said: "Not believing is also believing—is it so, or is it not?
translations.idiomatic: Nanfu said, "Not believing is also believing—is it so, or is it not?

sentences.zh: 雖虞舜之十二州，皆歸王化；

translations.literal: Although the twelve provinces of Yu Shun all returned to royal transformation;
translations.idiomatic: Although the twelve provinces of Yu Shun all returned to royal transformation;

sentences.zh: 然商於之六百里，當念爾欺！」

translations.literal: yet the six hundred li of Shangyu—remember your deceit!"
translations.idiomatic: yet the six hundred li of Shangyu—remember your deceit!"

sentences.zh: 飛曰：「救暫急而解倒懸，猶之可也；

translations.literal: Fei said: "To relieve a temporary emergency and undo an inverted hanging may still be acceptable;
translations.idiomatic: Fei said, "To relieve a temporary emergency and undo an inverted hanging may still be acceptable;

sentences.zh: 欲長慮而尊中國，豈其然乎？」

translations.literal: to wish for long-term planning and to honor the Central Realm—is that really so?"
translations.idiomatic: to wish for long-term planning and to honor the Central Realm—is that really so?"

sentences.zh: 他如秘書省正字汪應辰、樊光遠、澧州推官韓糸川、臨安府司戶參軍毛叔慶，皆言金人叵測；

translations.literal: Others such as Proofreader in the Secretariat Wang Yingchen, Fan Guangyuan, Judicial Officer of Lizhou Han Sichuan, and Administrative Assistant of Lin'an Prefecture Mao Shuqing all said the Jurchens were unpredictable;
translations.idiomatic: Others such as Proofreader Wang Yingchen, Fan Guangyuan, Judicial Officer of Lizhou Han Sichuan, and Administrative Assistant of Lin'an Prefecture Mao Shuqing all said the Jurchens were unpredictable;

sentences.zh: 迪功郎張行成獻《詢蕘書》二十篇，大意言自古講和，未有終不變者，條具者皆豫備之策。

translations.literal: Credentialed Gentleman Zhang Xingcheng presented twenty chapters of Inquiry of the Humble, the general purport being that from antiquity peace negotiations have never remained unchanged in the end, and the items listed were all preparatory strategies.
translations.idiomatic: Credentialed Gentleman Zhang Xingcheng presented twenty chapters of Inquiry of the Humble, arguing that from antiquity peace negotiations have never remained unchanged, and listing preparatory strategies for every contingency.

sentences.zh: 檜悉加黜責，糸川貶循州。

translations.literal: Hui had them all demoted and punished. Sichuan was demoted to Xunzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Hui had them all demoted and punished; Sichuan was exiled to Xunzhou.

sentences.zh: 七月，兀朮殺其領三省事宗磐及左副元帥撻懶，拘王倫於中山府。

translations.literal: In the seventh month Wuzhu killed Zongpan, who directed the Three Departments, and Left Deputy Marshal Tatala, and detained Wang Lun at Zhongshan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month Wuzhu killed Zongpan, who directed the Three Departments, and Left Deputy Marshal Tatala, and detained Wang Lun at Zhongshan Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 蓋兀朮以歸地為二人所主，將有他謀也。

translations.literal: For Wuzhu, because the return of territory had been advocated by these two men, was about to pursue other designs.
translations.idiomatic: Wuzhu, because the return of territory had been advocated by these two men, was about to pursue other designs.

sentences.zh: 倫嘗密奏於朝，檜不之備，但趣倫進。

translations.literal: Lun had once secretly memorialized the court, but Hui did not prepare for it and only urged Lun to advance.
translations.idiomatic: Lun had secretly memorialized the court, but Hui made no preparations and only urged Lun to proceed.

sentences.zh: 時韓世忠有乘懈掩擊之請，檜言《春秋》不伐喪，與帝意合，遂已。

translations.literal: At the time Han Shizhong had a request to strike while the enemy was off guard. Hui cited the Spring and Autumn Annals on not attacking during mourning, which accorded with the emperor's intent, and the matter was dropped.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Han Shizhong requested a surprise strike while the enemy was off guard; Hui cited the Spring and Autumn Annals on not attacking during mourning, which accorded with the emperor's intent, and the matter was dropped.

sentences.zh: 十年，金人果敗盟，分四道入侵。

translations.literal: In the tenth year the Jurchens indeed broke the treaty and invaded in four columns.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year the Jurchens indeed broke the treaty and invaded in four columns.

sentences.zh: 兀朮入東京，葛王褎取南京，李成取西京，撒離喝趨永興軍。

translations.literal: Wuzhu entered Dongjing, Prince Ge Xiuyu took Nanjing, Li Cheng took Xijing, and Salihuo pressed toward Yongxing Army.
translations.idiomatic: Wuzhu entered Dongjing, Prince Ge Xiuyu took Nanjing, Li Cheng took Xijing, and Salihuo pressed toward Yongxing Army.

sentences.zh: 河南諸郡相繼陷沒。

translations.literal: The prefectures of Henan fell in succession.
translations.idiomatic: The prefectures of Henan fell one after another.

sentences.zh: 帝始大怪，下詔罪狀兀朮。

translations.literal: The emperor was at first greatly astonished and issued an edict listing Wuzhu's crimes.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor was at first greatly astonished and issued an edict listing Wuzhu's crimes.

sentences.zh: 御史中丞王次翁奏曰：「前日國是，初無主議。

translations.literal: Censor-in-Chief Wang Ciweng memorialized: "On the previous national policy, there was at first no leading deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: Censor-in-Chief Wang Ciweng memorialized, "On the previous national policy, there was at first no leading deliberation.

sentences.zh: 事有小變，則更用他相，後來者未必賢，而排黜異黨，紛紛累月不能定，願陛下以為至戒。」

translations.literal: When affairs shifted slightly, another chief minister was appointed. The successor was not necessarily worthy, yet rival factions were driven out and dismissed, and for months on end nothing could be settled. I hope Your Majesty will take this as the greatest warning."
translations.idiomatic: When affairs shifted slightly, another chief minister was appointed—the successor was not necessarily worthy, yet rival factions were driven out, and for months on end nothing could be settled; I hope Your Majesty will take this as the greatest warning."

sentences.zh: 帝深然之。

translations.literal: The emperor deeply agreed.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor deeply agreed.

sentences.zh: 檜力排群言，始終以和議自任，而次翁謂無主議者，專為檜地也。

translations.literal: Hui forcefully rejected all other opinions and from first to last took peace talks upon himself, while Ciweng's words about there being no leading deliberation were made specially to clear ground for Hui.
translations.idiomatic: Hui forcefully rejected all other opinions and consistently took peace talks upon himself, while Ciweng's words about there being no leading deliberation were made specially to clear ground for Hui.

sentences.zh: 於是檜位復安，據之凡十八年，公論不能撼搖矣。

translations.literal: Thereupon Hui's position was secure again. He held it for eighteen years in all, and public opinion could not shake him.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon Hui's position was secure again; he held it for eighteen years in all, and public opinion could not shake him.

sentences.zh: 六月，檜奏曰：「德無常師，主善為師。

translations.literal: In the sixth month Hui memorialized: "Virtue has no fixed teacher—take what is good as teacher.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month Hui memorialized, "Virtue has no fixed teacher—take what is good as teacher.

sentences.zh: 臣昨見撻懶有割地講和之議，故贊陛下取河南故疆。

translations.literal: Your minister previously saw that Tatala had a proposal to cede territory and negotiate peace, and therefore supported Your Majesty in recovering the former borders of Henan.
translations.idiomatic: Your minister previously saw that Tatala had proposed ceding territory and negotiating peace, and therefore supported Your Majesty in recovering the former borders of Henan.

sentences.zh: 今兀朮戕其叔撻懶，藍公佐歸，和議已變，故贊陛下定吊伐之計。

translations.literal: Now Wuzhu has killed his uncle Tatala, and Lan Gongzuo has returned. The peace talks have changed, and therefore I support Your Majesty in settling on a plan of condolence and punitive expedition.
translations.idiomatic: Now Wuzhu has killed his uncle Tatala, and Lan Gongzuo has returned—the peace talks have changed, and therefore I support Your Majesty in settling on a plan of punitive expedition.

sentences.zh: 願至江上諭諸帥同力招討。」

translations.literal: I wish to go to the river region and instruct the commanders to join forces in recruitment and suppression."
translations.idiomatic: I wish to go to the river region and instruct the commanders to join forces in recruitment and suppression."

sentences.zh: 卒不行。

translations.literal: In the end he did not go.
translations.idiomatic: In the end he did not go.

sentences.zh: 閏六月，貶趙鼎興化軍，以王次翁受檜旨，言其規圖復用也。

translations.literal: In the intercalary sixth month Zhao Ding was demoted to Xinghua Army. Wang Ciweng, acting on Hui's instruction, said Ding was plotting to be restored to office.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary sixth month Zhao Ding was demoted to Xinghua Army; Wang Ciweng, acting on Hui's instruction, said Ding was plotting to be restored to office.

sentences.zh: 言者不已，尋竄潮州。

translations.literal: Critics would not cease, and soon he was exiled to Chaozhou.
translations.idiomatic: Critics would not cease, and soon he was exiled to Chaozhou.

sentences.zh: 時張俊克亳州，王勝克海州，岳飛克郾城，幾獲兀朮。

translations.literal: At the time Zhang Jun captured Bozhou, Wang Sheng captured Haizhou, and Yue Fei captured Yancheng, nearly capturing Wuzhu.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Zhang Jun captured Bozhou, Wang Sheng captured Haizhou, and Yue Fei captured Yancheng, nearly capturing Wuzhu.

sentences.zh: 張浚戰勝于長安，韓世忠勝於泇口鎮，諸將所向皆奏捷，而檜力主班師。

translations.literal: Zhang Jun was victorious at Chang'an, Han Shizhong was victorious at Jiakou, and the generals wherever they went all reported victories, yet Hui strongly advocated withdrawing the army.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Jun was victorious at Chang'an, Han Shizhong at Jiakou, and the generals wherever they went reported victories—yet Hui strongly advocated withdrawing the army.

sentences.zh: 九月，詔飛還行在，沂中還鎮江，光世還池州，錡還太平。

translations.literal: In the ninth month an edict ordered Fei to return to the traveling court, Yizhong to Jiangjiang, Guangshi to Chizhou, and Qi to Taiping.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month an edict ordered Fei to return to the traveling court, Yizhong to Zhenjiang, Guangshi to Chizhou, and Qi to Taiping.

sentences.zh: 飛軍聞詔，旗靡轍亂，飛口呿不能合。

translations.literal: When Fei's army heard the edict, banners drooped and ranks fell into disorder. Fei's mouth hung open and would not close.
translations.idiomatic: When Fei's army heard the edict, banners drooped and ranks fell into disorder; Fei's mouth hung open and would not close.

sentences.zh: 於是淮甯、蔡、鄭復為金人有。

translations.literal: Thereupon Huaining, Cai, and Zheng again became possessions of the Jurchens.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon Huaining, Cai, and Zheng again fell to the Jurchens.

sentences.zh: 以明堂恩封檜莘國公。

translations.literal: On the Hall of Brightness grace Hui was enfeoffed as Duke of Shen.
translations.idiomatic: On the Hall of Brightness grace Hui was enfeoffed as Duke of Shen.

sentences.zh: 十一年，兀朮再舉，取壽春，入廬州，諸將邵隆、王德、關師古等連戰皆捷。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year Wuzhu invaded again, took Shouchun, and entered Luzhou. The generals Shao Long, Wang De, Guan Shigu, and others won successive victories in battle.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year Wuzhu invaded again, took Shouchun, and entered Luzhou; the generals Shao Long, Wang De, Guan Shigu, and others won successive victories.

sentences.zh: 楊沂中戰拓皋，又破之。

translations.literal: Yang Yizhong fought at Tuogao and defeated the enemy again.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Yizhong fought at Tuogao and defeated the enemy again.

sentences.zh: 檜忽諭沂中及張俊遽班師。

translations.literal: Hui suddenly instructed Yizhong and Zhang Jun to withdraw the army at once.
translations.idiomatic: Hui suddenly instructed Yizhong and Zhang Jun to withdraw the army at once.

sentences.zh: 韓世忠聞之，止濠州不進；

translations.literal: When Han Shizhong heard it, he halted at Haozhou and did not advance;
translations.idiomatic: When Han Shizhong heard it, he halted at Haozhou and did not advance;

sentences.zh: 劉錡聞之，棄壽春而歸。

translations.literal: when Liu Qi heard it, he abandoned Shouchun and returned.
translations.idiomatic: when Liu Qi heard it, he abandoned Shouchun and returned.

sentences.zh: 自是不復出兵。

translations.literal: From this time troops were no longer sent out.
translations.idiomatic: From this time troops were no longer sent out.

sentences.zh: 四月，檜欲盡收諸將兵權，給事中範同獻策，檜納之。

translations.literal: In the fourth month Hui wished to take all military authority from the generals. Drafting Reviewer Fan Tong offered a plan, and Hui adopted it.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month Hui wished to take all military authority from the generals; Drafting Reviewer Fan Tong offered a plan, and Hui adopted it.

sentences.zh: 密奏召三大將論功行賞，韓世忠、張俊並為樞密使，岳飛為副使，以宣撫司軍隸樞密院。

translations.literal: In a secret memorial he proposed summoning the three great generals to discuss merit and grant rewards. Han Shizhong and Zhang Jun were both made Commissioners of Military Affairs, Yue Fei was made Vice Commissioner, and the armies of the pacification commissions were placed under the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In a secret memorial he proposed summoning the three great generals to discuss merit and grant rewards; Han Shizhong and Zhang Jun were both made Commissioners of Military Affairs, Yue Fei Vice Commissioner, and the pacification armies were placed under the Bureau of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 六月，拜左僕射、同中書門下平章事兼樞密使，進封慶國公。

translations.literal: In the sixth month he was appointed Left Vice Director, Co-Grand Councillor of the Secretariat-Chancellery, and concurrent Commissioner of Military Affairs, and advanced to Duke of Qing.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month he was appointed Left Vice Director, Co-Grand Councillor of the Secretariat-Chancellery, and concurrent Commissioner of Military Affairs, and advanced to Duke of Qing.

sentences.zh: 《徽宗實錄》成，遷少保，加封冀國公。

translations.literal: When the Veritable Records of Emperor Huizong were completed, he was transferred to Junior Preceptor and additionally enfeoffed as Duke of Ji.
translations.idiomatic: When the Veritable Records of Emperor Huizong were completed, he was transferred to Junior Preceptor and additionally enfeoffed as Duke of Ji.

sentences.zh: 先是，莫將、韓恕使金，拘於涿州。

translations.literal: Earlier Mo Jiang and Han Shu had been sent as envoys to Jin and were detained at Zhuozhou.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier Mo Jiang and Han Shu had been sent as envoys to Jin and were detained at Zhuozhou.

sentences.zh: 至是，兀朮有求和意，縱之歸。

translations.literal: By this time Wuzhu had an intent to seek peace and released them to return.
translations.idiomatic: By this time Wuzhu wished to seek peace and released them to return.

sentences.zh: 檜復奏遣劉光遠、曹勳使金，又以魏良臣為通問使。

translations.literal: Hui again memorialized to send Liu Guangyuan and Cao Xun as envoys to Jin, and also appointed Wei Liangchen as communication envoy.
translations.idiomatic: Hui again memorialized to send Liu Guangyuan and Cao Xun as envoys to Jin, and appointed Wei Liangchen as communication envoy.

sentences.zh: 未幾，良臣偕金使蕭毅等來，議以淮水為界，求割唐、鄧二州。

translations.literal: Before long Liangchen came together with Jin envoys Xiao Yi and others, proposing the Huai River as boundary and demanding the cession of Tang and Deng prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: Before long Liangchen came together with Jin envoys Xiao Yi and others, proposing the Huai River as boundary and demanding the cession of Tang and Deng prefectures.

sentences.zh: 尋遣何鑄報聘，許之。

translations.literal: Soon He Zhu was sent on a return embassy and the terms were accepted.
translations.idiomatic: Soon He Zhu was sent on a return embassy and the terms were accepted.

sentences.zh: 十月，興岳飛之獄。

translations.literal: In the tenth month the case against Yue Fei was opened.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month the case against Yue Fei was opened.

sentences.zh: 檜使諫官万俟禼論其罪，張俊又誣飛舊將張憲謀反，於是飛及子雲俱送大理寺，命御史中丞何鑄、大理卿周三畏鞫之。

translations.literal: Hui had remonstrance official Wan Qixie argue his crimes. Zhang Jun further falsely accused Fei's former general Zhang Xian of plotting rebellion. Thereupon Fei and his son Yun were both sent to the Court of Judicial Review, and Censor-in-Chief He Zhu and Chief Judge of the Court Zhou Sanwei were ordered to interrogate them.
translations.idiomatic: Hui had remonstrance official Wan Qixie argue his crimes; Zhang Jun further falsely accused Fei's former general Zhang Xian of plotting rebellion; Fei and his son Yun were sent to the Court of Judicial Review, and Censor-in-Chief He Zhu and Chief Judge Zhou Sanwei were ordered to interrogate them.

sentences.zh: 十一月，貶李光藤州，範同罷參知政事。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month Li Guang was demoted to Tengzhou and Fan Tong was dismissed as Vice Director.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month Li Guang was demoted to Tengzhou and Fan Tong was dismissed as Vice Director.

sentences.zh: 同雖附和議，以自奏事，檜忌之也。

translations.literal: Although Tong had endorsed peace talks, he memorialized on his own authority, and Hui envied him for it.
translations.idiomatic: Although Tong had endorsed peace talks, he memorialized on his own authority, and Hui resented him for it.

sentences.zh: 十二月，殺岳飛。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month Yue Fei was executed.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month Yue Fei was executed.

sentences.zh: 檜以飛屢言和議失計，且嘗奏請定國本，俱與檜大異，必欲殺之。

translations.literal: Because Fei had repeatedly said peace talks were a mistaken plan and had once memorialized to fix the heir apparent—all greatly at odds with Hui—Hui was determined to kill him.
translations.idiomatic: Because Fei had repeatedly said peace talks were a mistaken plan and had once memorialized to fix the heir apparent—all greatly at odds with Hui—Hui was determined to kill him.

sentences.zh: 鑄、三畏初鞫，久不伏；

translations.literal: Zhu and Sanwei at first interrogated him, but for a long time he would not confess;
translations.idiomatic: Zhu and Sanwei at first interrogated him, but for a long time he would not confess;

sentences.zh: 禼入台，獄遂上。

translations.literal: when Qixie entered the censorate, the case was finally submitted.
translations.idiomatic: when Qixie entered the censorate, the case was finally submitted.

sentences.zh: 誣飛嘗自言「己與太祖皆三十歲建節」為指斥乘輿，受詔不救淮西罪，賜死獄中。

translations.literal: They falsely accused Fei of once saying "Both I and Taizu received military commissions at thirty" as an insult to the throne, and of the crime of receiving an edict but failing to rescue Huai West. He was granted death in prison.
translations.idiomatic: They falsely accused Fei of once saying "Both I and Taizu received military commissions at thirty" as an insult to the throne, and of failing to rescue Huai West when ordered; he was granted death in prison.

sentences.zh: 子雲及張憲殺於都市。

translations.literal: His son Yun and Zhang Xian were executed in the capital market.
translations.idiomatic: His son Yun and Zhang Xian were executed in the capital market.

sentences.zh: 天下冤之，聞者流涕。

translations.literal: All under Heaven considered it an injustice; those who heard wept.
translations.idiomatic: All under Heaven considered it an injustice; those who heard wept.

sentences.zh: 飛之死，張俊有力焉，語在《飛傳》。

translations.literal: In Fei's death Zhang Jun had a strong hand; the account is in the Biography of Fei.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Jun had a strong hand in Fei's death; the account is in the Biography of Fei.

sentences.zh: 十二年，胡銓再編管新州。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year Hu Quan was again placed under supervised exile at Xinzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year Hu Quan was again placed under supervised exile at Xinzhou.

sentences.zh: 八月，徽宗及顯肅、懿節二梓宮至行在。

translations.literal: In the eighth month the imperial coffins of Emperor Huizong and the Empresses Xiansu and Yijie arrived at the traveling court.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month the imperial coffins of Emperor Huizong and Empresses Xiansu and Yijie arrived at the traveling court.

sentences.zh: 太后還慈甯宮。

translations.literal: The empress dowager returned to the Cining Palace.
translations.idiomatic: The empress dowager returned to the Cining Palace.

sentences.zh: 九月，加太師，進封魏國公。

translations.literal: In the ninth month he was made Grand Preceptor and advanced to Duke of Wei.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month he was made Grand Preceptor and advanced to Duke of Wei.

sentences.zh: 十月，進封秦、魏兩國公。

translations.literal: In the tenth month he was advanced to Duke of both Qin and Wei.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month he was advanced to Duke of both Qin and Wei.

sentences.zh: 檜以封兩國與蔡京、童貫同，請改封母為秦、魏國夫人。

translations.literal: Because enfeoffment as duke of two states was the same as Cai Jing and Tong Guan, Hui requested that his mother be enfeoffed as Lady of Qin and Wei instead.
translations.idiomatic: Because enfeoffment as duke of two states matched Cai Jing and Tong Guan, Hui requested that his mother be enfeoffed as Lady of Qin and Wei instead.

sentences.zh: 子熺舉進士，館客何溥赴南省，皆為第一。

translations.literal: His son Xi passed the jinshi examination, and his client He Pu went to the southern capital examination—both ranked first.
translations.idiomatic: His son Xi passed the jinshi examination, and his client He Pu went to the southern capital examination—both ranked first.

sentences.zh: 熺本王唤孽子，檜妻喚妹，無子，喚妻貴而妒，檜在金國，齣熺爲檜後。

translations.literal: Xi was originally the illegitimate son of Wang Huan. Hui's wife was Huan's younger sister. Having no son, and Huan's wife being noble and jealous, while Hui was in the Jin state she presented Xi as Hui's heir.
translations.idiomatic: Xi was originally the illegitimate son of Wang Huan; Hui's wife was Huan's younger sister—childless, and with Huan's wife being proud and jealous—while Hui was in the Jin state she presented Xi as Hui's heir.

sentences.zh: 檜還，其家以熺見，檜喜甚。

translations.literal: When Hui returned, his family presented Xi to him, and Hui was greatly pleased.
translations.idiomatic: When Hui returned, his family presented Xi to him, and Hui was greatly pleased.

sentences.zh: 檜幸和議復成，益咎前日之異己者。

translations.literal: Hui, fortunate that peace talks were restored, blamed all the more those who had differed from him in earlier days.
translations.idiomatic: Fortunate that peace talks were restored, Hui blamed all the more those who had differed from him in earlier days.

sentences.zh: 先是，趙鼎貶潮州，王庶貶道州，胡銓再貶新州。

translations.literal: Earlier Zhao Ding had been demoted to Chaozhou, Wang Shu to Daozhou, and Hu Quan again to Xinzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier Zhao Ding had been demoted to Chaozhou, Wang Shu to Daozhou, and Hu Quan again to Xinzhou.

sentences.zh: 至是，皆遇赦永不檢舉。

translations.literal: By this time, all encountered amnesties from which they would never be reported for release.
translations.idiomatic: By this time, all encountered amnesties from which they would never be eligible for release.

sentences.zh: 曾開、李彌遜並落職。

translations.literal: Zeng Kai and Li Mixun were both stripped of office.
translations.idiomatic: Zeng Kai and Li Mixun were both stripped of office.

sentences.zh: 張俊本助和議，居位歲餘無去意，檜諷江邈論罷之。

translations.literal: Zhang Jun had originally helped the peace talks and, holding office for more than a year, showed no intent to leave. Hui prompted Jiang Miao to argue for his dismissal.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Jun had originally helped the peace talks and, holding office for more than a year, showed no intent to leave; Hui prompted Jiang Miao to argue for his dismissal.

sentences.zh: 十三年，賀瑞雪，賀雪自檜始。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year auspicious snow was celebrated—a practice that began with Hui.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year auspicious snow was celebrated—a practice that began with Hui.

sentences.zh: 賀日食不見，是後日食多書不見。

translations.literal: Eclipses in which the sun was not seen were celebrated; thereafter solar eclipses were often recorded as unseen.
translations.idiomatic: Eclipses in which the sun was not seen were celebrated; thereafter solar eclipses were often recorded as unseen.

sentences.zh: 彗星常見，選人康倬上書言彗星不足畏，檜大喜，特改京秩。

translations.literal: Comets appeared frequently. Examination candidate Kang Zhuo submitted a memorial saying comets were not to be feared. Hui was greatly pleased and specially transferred him to a capital rank.
translations.idiomatic: Comets appeared frequently; examination candidate Kang Zhuo submitted a memorial saying comets were not to be feared—Hui was greatly pleased and specially transferred him to a capital rank.

sentences.zh: 楚州奏鹽城縣海清，檜請賀，帝不許。

translations.literal: Chuzhou reported that the sea at Yancheng County was clear. Hui requested celebration, but the emperor did not permit it.
translations.idiomatic: Chuzhou reported that the sea at Yancheng County was clear; Hui requested celebration, but the emperor refused.

sentences.zh: 知虔州薛弼言木內有文曰「天下太平年」，詔付史館。

translations.literal: Prefect of Qianzhou Xue Bi said that within a tree were characters reading "Years of peace under Heaven." An edict ordered it sent to the Historiography Office.
translations.idiomatic: Prefect of Qianzhou Xue Bi reported characters within a tree reading "Years of peace under Heaven"; an edict ordered it sent to the Historiography Office.

sentences.zh: 於是修飾彌文，以粉飾治具，如鄉飲、耕籍之類節節備舉，為苟安余杭之計，自此不復巡幸江上，而祥瑞之奏日聞矣。

translations.literal: Thereupon ornate rhetoric was increasingly used to embellish the apparatus of governance. Such things as village drinking ceremonies and plowing at the altar were performed step by step in full, as a plan for complacent security at Hangzhou. From this time the emperor no longer toured the river region, and reports of auspicious omens were heard daily.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon ornate rhetoric was increasingly used to embellish the apparatus of governance—village drinking ceremonies, plowing at the altar, and the like performed step by step in full—as a plan for complacent security at Hangzhou; from this time the emperor no longer toured the river region, and reports of auspicious omens were heard daily.

sentences.zh: 洪皓歸自金國，名節獨著，以致金酋室撚語，直翰苑不一月逐去。

translations.literal: Hong Hao returned from the Jin state with outstanding reputation and integrity, but because he repeated words of the Jurchen chief's attendant Shinie, he was appointed to the Hanlin Academy and driven out within a month.
translations.idiomatic: Hong Hao returned from the Jin state with outstanding reputation and integrity, but because he repeated words of the Jurchen chief's attendant Shinie, he was appointed to the Hanlin Academy and driven out within a month.

sentences.zh: 室撚者，閣，粘罕之左右也。

translations.literal: Shinie was Ge, an attendant of Nianhan.
translations.idiomatic: Shinie was Ge, an attendant of Nianhan.

sentences.zh: 初，粘罕行軍至淮上，檜嘗為之草檄，為室撚所見，故因皓歸寄聲。

translations.literal: Earlier, when Nianhan's army marched to the Huai region, Hui had once drafted a proclamation for him, which Shinie had seen. Therefore, through Hao's return, he sent a message.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, when Nianhan's army marched to the Huai region, Hui had once drafted a proclamation for him, which Shinie had seen; therefore, through Hao's return, he sent a message.

sentences.zh: 檜意士大夫莫有知者，聞皓語，深以為憾，遂令李文會論之。

translations.literal: Hui thought no scholar-official knew of this. Hearing Hao's words, he deeply resented it and had Li Wenhui argue against him.
translations.idiomatic: Hui thought no scholar-official knew of this; hearing Hao's words, he deeply resented it and had Li Wenhui argue against him.

sentences.zh: 胡舜陟以非笑朝政下獄死，張九成以鼓唱浮言貶，累及僧宗杲，編配，皆以語忤檜也。

translations.literal: Hu Shunzhi was imprisoned and died for mocking court governance. Zhang Jiucheng was demoted for stirring up loose talk. The monk Zonggao was implicated and assigned to supervised exile—all because their words offended Hui.
translations.idiomatic: Hu Shunzhi was imprisoned and died for mocking court governance; Zhang Jiucheng was demoted for stirring up loose talk; the monk Zonggao was implicated and assigned to supervised exile—all because their words offended Hui.

sentences.zh: 張邵亦坐與檜言金人有歸欽宗及諸王后妃意，斥為外祠。

translations.literal: Zhang Shao was also punished for telling Hui that the Jurchens intended to return Emperor Qinzong and the princes, queens, and consorts, and was dismissed to an outer temple commission.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Shao was also punished for telling Hui that the Jurchens intended to return Emperor Qinzong and the princes, queens, and consorts, and was dismissed to an outer temple commission.

sentences.zh: 十四年，貶黃龜年，以前嘗論檜也。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year Huang Guinian was demoted, because he had once argued against Hui.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year Huang Guinian was demoted because he had once argued against Hui.

sentences.zh: 閩、浙大水，右武大夫白鍔有「燮理乖謬」語，刺配萬安軍。

translations.literal: Great floods struck Min and Zhe. Right Martial Grandee Bai E used the words "governance is perversely mistaken" and was tattooed and assigned to Wan'an Army.
translations.idiomatic: Great floods struck Min and Zhe; Right Martial Grandee Bai E used the words "governance is perversely mistaken" and was tattooed and exiled to Wan'an Army.

sentences.zh: 太學生張伯麟嘗題壁曰「夫差，爾忘越王殺而父乎」，杖脊刺配吉陽軍。

translations.literal: Imperial Academy student Zhang Boli once wrote on a wall: "Fuchai, have you forgotten that the King of Yue killed your father?" He was beaten on the back, tattooed, and assigned to Jiyang Army.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial Academy student Zhang Boli once wrote on a wall, "Fuchai, have you forgotten that the King of Yue killed your father?" He was beaten on the back, tattooed, and exiled to Jiyang Army.

sentences.zh: 故將解潛罷官閒居，辛永宗總戎外郡，亦坐不附和議，潛竄南安死，永宗編置肇慶死。

translations.literal: Former general Xie Qian, dismissed and living in retirement, and Xin Yongzong, commanding troops in an outer prefecture, were also punished for not endorsing peace talks. Qian was exiled to Nan'an and died; Yongzong was assigned to Zhaoqing and died.
translations.idiomatic: Former general Xie Qian, dismissed and living in retirement, and Xin Yongzong, commanding troops in an outer prefecture, were also punished for not endorsing peace talks—Qian was exiled to Nan'an and died; Yongzong was assigned to Zhaoqing and died.

sentences.zh: 趙鼎、李光皆再竄過海。

translations.literal: Zhao Ding and Li Guang were both again exiled across the sea.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Ding and Li Guang were both again exiled across the sea.

sentences.zh: 皓之罪由白鍔延譽，光以在藤州唱和有諷刺及檜者，為守臣所告也。

translations.literal: Hao's crime arose from Bai E's praise of him. Guang, because while at Tengzhou he joined in poetic exchange containing satire directed at Hui, was reported by the defending official.
translations.idiomatic: Hao's crime arose from Bai E's praise of him; Guang, because while at Tengzhou he joined in poetic exchange containing satire directed at Hui, was reported by the defending official.

sentences.zh: 先是，議建國公出閣，吏部尚書吳表臣、禮部尚書蘇符等七人論禮與檜意異，於是表臣等以討論不祥、懷奸附鼎皆罷。

translations.literal: Earlier, when the Duke of Jianguo's departure from the palace was discussed, Minister of Personnel Wu Biaochen, Minister of Rites Su Fu, and five others argued ritual matters at odds with Hui's intent. Thereupon Biaochen and the others were all dismissed for discussing inauspicious matters and harboring treachery by attaching themselves to Ding.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, when the Duke of Jianguo's departure from the palace was discussed, Minister of Personnel Wu Biaochen, Minister of Rites Su Fu, and five others argued ritual matters at odds with Hui's intent; Biaochen and the others were all dismissed for discussing inauspicious matters and harboring treachery by attaching themselves to Ding.

sentences.zh: 始，檜為上言：趙鼎欲立皇太子，是待陛下終無子也，宜俟親子乃立。

translations.literal: At the beginning Hui said to the emperor: Zhao Ding wishes to install the crown prince—this means treating Your Majesty as ultimately having no son. One should wait until a biological son is born before installing an heir.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning Hui told the emperor, "Zhao Ding wishes to install the crown prince—this means treating Your Majesty as ultimately having no son; one should wait until a biological son is born before installing an heir."

sentences.zh: 遂嗾御史中丞詹大方言鼎邪謀密計，深不可測，與范冲等咸懷異意，以徼無妄之福。

translations.literal: He then prompted Censor-in-Chief Zhan Dafang to say that Ding had treacherous schemes and secret plots, deeply unfathomable, and that he and Fan Chong and others all harbored divergent intent, seeking undeserved fortune.
translations.idiomatic: He then prompted Censor-in-Chief Zhan Dafang to say that Ding had treacherous schemes and secret plots, deeply unfathomable, and that he and Fan Chong and others all harbored divergent intent, seeking undeserved fortune.

sentences.zh: 沖嘗為資善翊善，故大方誣之。

translations.literal: Chong had once served as assistant tutor in the Hall of Nurturing Virtue, and therefore Dafang falsely accused him.
translations.idiomatic: Chong had once served as assistant tutor in the Hall of Nurturing Virtue, and therefore Dafang falsely accused him.

sentences.zh: 其後監察御史王鎡言帝未有嗣，宜祠高禖，詔築壇於圜丘東，皆檜意也。

translations.literal: Afterward Supervising Censor Wang Zi said the emperor had no heir and should sacrifice to Gaomei. An edict ordered an altar built east of the Round Mound—all Hui's intent.
translations.idiomatic: Afterward Supervising Censor Wang Zi said the emperor had no heir and should sacrifice to Gaomei; an edict ordered an altar built east of the Round Mound—all Hui's intent.

sentences.zh: 台州曾惇獻檜詩稱「聖相」。

translations.literal: Zeng Dun of Taizhou presented a poem to Hui calling him "sage chief minister."
translations.idiomatic: Zeng Dun of Taizhou presented a poem to Hui calling him "sage chief minister."

sentences.zh: 凡投獻者以皋、夔、稷、契為不足，必曰「元聖」。

translations.literal: All who presented offerings found Gao Yao, Kui, Hou Ji, and Qi insufficient and always said "primordial sage."
translations.idiomatic: All who presented offerings found Gao Yao, Kui, Hou Ji, and Qi insufficient and always said "primordial sage."

sentences.zh: 檜乞禁野史。

translations.literal: Hui requested a ban on unofficial histories.
translations.idiomatic: Hui requested a ban on unofficial histories.

sentences.zh: 又命子熺以秘書少監、領國史，進建炎元年至紹興十二年《日曆》五百九十卷。

translations.literal: He also ordered his son Xi, as Deputy Director of the Secretariat, to direct the national history and submit five hundred and ninety juan of Calendar from the first year of Jianyan to the twelfth year of Shaoxing.
translations.idiomatic: He also ordered his son Xi, as Deputy Director of the Secretariat, to direct the national history and submit five hundred and ninety juan of Calendar from the first year of Jianyan to the twelfth year of Shaoxing.

sentences.zh: 熺因太后北還，自頌檜功德凡二千餘言，使著作郎王揚英、周執羔上之，皆遷秩。

translations.literal: Because the empress dowager returned from the north, Xi himself praised Hui's merit and virtue in more than two thousand words and had Compilers Wang Yangying and Zhou Zhigao submit it. All were promoted in rank.
translations.idiomatic: Because the empress dowager returned from the north, Xi himself praised Hui's merit and virtue in more than two thousand words and had Compilers Wang Yangying and Zhou Zhigao submit it—all were promoted in rank.

sentences.zh: 自檜再相，凡前罷相以來詔書章疏稍及檜者，率更易焚棄，日曆、時政亡失已多，是後記錄皆熺筆，無復有公是非矣。

translations.literal: Since Hui became chief minister again, all edicts and memorials since his earlier dismissal that even slightly mentioned Hui were generally altered or burned. Much of the Calendar and Current Affairs records were lost. Thereafter all records were written by Xi's hand, and there was no longer any public right and wrong.
translations.idiomatic: Since Hui became chief minister again, all edicts and memorials since his earlier dismissal that even slightly mentioned him were generally altered or burned; much of the Calendar and Current Affairs records were lost, and thereafter all records were written by Xi's hand—there was no longer any public right and wrong.

sentences.zh: 冬十月，右正言何若指程頤、張載遺書為專門曲學，力加禁絕，人無敢以為非。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter Right Remonstrator He Ruo pointed to the posthumous writings of Cheng Yi and Zhang Zai as specialized and biased learning and forcefully sought their prohibition. No one dared say it was wrong.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter Right Remonstrator He Ruo pointed to the posthumous writings of Cheng Yi and Zhang Zai as specialized and biased learning and forcefully sought their prohibition—no one dared say it was wrong.

sentences.zh: 十五年，熺除翰林學士兼侍讀。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year Xi was appointed Hanlin Academician and concurrent Lecturer.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year Xi was appointed Hanlin Academician and concurrent Lecturer.

sentences.zh: 四月，賜檜甲第，命教坊樂導之入，賜緡錢金綿有差。

translations.literal: In the fourth month a mansion was granted to Hui. The Music Bureau was ordered to lead him in with music, and strings of cash, gold, and silk were granted in varying amounts.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month a mansion was granted to Hui; the Music Bureau was ordered to lead him in with music, and strings of cash, gold, and silk were granted in varying amounts.

sentences.zh: 六月，帝幸檜第，檜妻婦子孫皆加恩。

translations.literal: In the sixth month the emperor visited Hui's residence. Hui's wife, daughters-in-law, sons, and grandsons were all granted favors.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month the emperor visited Hui's residence; Hui's wife, daughters-in-law, sons, and grandsons were all granted favors.

sentences.zh: 檜先禁私史，七月，又對帝言私史害正道。

translations.literal: Hui had earlier banned private histories. In the seventh month he again told the emperor in audience that private histories harmed the correct Way.
translations.idiomatic: Hui had earlier banned private histories; in the seventh month he again told the emperor in audience that private histories harmed the correct Way.

sentences.zh: 時司馬伋遂言《涑水記聞》非其曾祖光論著之書，其後李光家亦舉光所藏書萬卷焚之。

translations.literal: At the time Sima Ji then said that Records of Suishui was not a work written by his great-grandfather Guang. Afterward Li Guang's family also brought out the ten thousand juan Guang had collected and burned them.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Sima Ji then said that Records of Suishui was not a work written by his great-grandfather Guang; afterward Li Guang's family also brought out the ten thousand juan Guang had collected and burned them.

sentences.zh: 十月，帝親書「一德格天」扁其閣。

translations.literal: In the tenth month the emperor personally wrote the plaque "Single virtue matches Heaven" for his hall.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month the emperor personally wrote the plaque "Single virtue matches Heaven" for his hall.

sentences.zh: 十六年正月，檜立家廟。

translations.literal: In the first month of the sixteenth year Hui established a family temple.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the sixteenth year Hui established a family temple.

sentences.zh: 三月，賜祭器，將相賜祭器自檜始。

translations.literal: In the third month ritual vessels were granted. The granting of ritual vessels to chief ministers and generals began with Hui.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month ritual vessels were granted—the granting of ritual vessels to chief ministers and generals began with Hui.

sentences.zh: 先是，帝以彗星見求言。

translations.literal: Earlier, because a comet appeared, the emperor requested opinions.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, because a comet appeared, the emperor requested opinions.

sentences.zh: 張浚上疏，言：「今事勢如養大疽于頭目心腹之間，不決不止，願謀為豫備。

translations.literal: Zhang Jun submitted a memorial saying: "The present situation is like nurturing a great ulcer between the head, eyes, and vital organs—it will not stop unless cut out. I wish to plan preparations in advance.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Jun submitted a memorial saying, "The present situation is like nurturing a great ulcer between the head, eyes, and vital organs—it will not stop unless cut out; I wish to plan preparations in advance.

sentences.zh: 不然，異時以國與敵者，反歸罪正議。」

translations.literal: Otherwise, when the time comes that the state is given to the enemy, blame will instead be placed on upright deliberation."
translations.idiomatic: Otherwise, when the time comes that the state is given to the enemy, blame will instead be placed on upright deliberation."

sentences.zh: 檜久憾浚，至是大怒，即落浚節鉞，貶連州，尋移永州。

translations.literal: Hui had long resented Jun. At this he was greatly angered and at once stripped Jun of his military commission, demoted him to Lianzhou, and soon transferred him to Yongzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Hui had long resented Jun; at this he was greatly angered, stripped Jun of his military commission, demoted him to Lianzhou, and soon transferred him to Yongzhou.

sentences.zh: 十七年，改封檜益國公。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year Hui was re-enfeoffed as Duke of Yi.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year Hui was re-enfeoffed as Duke of Yi.

sentences.zh: 五月，移貶洪皓于英州。

translations.literal: In the fifth month Hong Hao was transferred and demoted to Yingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month Hong Hao was transferred and demoted to Yingzhou.

sentences.zh: 八月，趙鼎死于吉陽軍。

translations.literal: In the eighth month Zhao Ding died at Jiyang Army.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month Zhao Ding died at Jiyang Army.

sentences.zh: 是夏，先有趙鼎遇赦永不檢舉之旨，又令月申存亡，鼎知之，不食而卒。

translations.literal: That summer there had first been an edict that Zhao Ding, encountering amnesty, would never be reported for release, and also an order to report monthly whether he was alive or dead. Ding learned of this, stopped eating, and died.
translations.idiomatic: That summer there had first been an edict that Zhao Ding, encountering amnesty, would never be reported for release, and also an order to report monthly whether he was alive or dead; Ding learned of this, stopped eating, and died.

sentences.zh: 自鼎之謫，門人故吏皆被羅織，雖聞其死而歎息者亦加以罪。

translations.literal: From Ding's demotion, his students and former subordinates were all entangled in fabricated charges. Even those who sighed upon hearing of his death were punished.
translations.idiomatic: From Ding's demotion, his students and former subordinates were all entangled in fabricated charges—even those who sighed upon hearing of his death were punished.

sentences.zh: 又竄呂頤浩子摭於藤州。

translations.literal: Lü Yihao's son Zhi was also exiled to Tengzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Lü Yihao's son Zhi was also exiled to Tengzhou.

sentences.zh: 十二月，進士施鍔上《中興頌》、《行都賦》及《紹興雅》十篇，永免文解。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month jinshi Shi E submitted Ode to the Restoration, Rhapsody on the Traveling Capital, and ten chapters of Shaoxing Elegances, and was permanently exempted from the literary examination.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month jinshi Shi E submitted Ode to the Restoration, Rhapsody on the Traveling Capital, and ten chapters of Shaoxing Elegances, and was permanently exempted from the literary examination.

sentences.zh: 自此頌詠導諛愈多。

translations.literal: From this time praise and flattery grew ever more.
translations.idiomatic: From this time praise and flattery grew ever more.

sentences.zh: 賜百官喜雪禦筵於檜第。

translations.literal: An imperial banquet celebrating auspicious snow was granted to the officials at Hui's residence.
translations.idiomatic: An imperial banquet celebrating auspicious snow was granted to the officials at Hui's residence.

sentences.zh: 十八年，熺除知樞密院事，檜問胡寧曰：「外議如何？」

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year Xi was appointed Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs. Hui asked Hu Ning: "What is the outside talk?"
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year Xi was appointed Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs; Hui asked Hu Ning, "What is the outside talk?"

sentences.zh: 寧曰：「以為公相必不襲蔡京之跡。」

translations.literal: Ning said: "They think the chief minister and grand councillor will surely not follow in Cai Jing's footsteps."
translations.idiomatic: Ning said, "They think the chief minister and grand councillor will surely not follow in Cai Jing's footsteps."

sentences.zh: 五月，李顯忠上恢復策，落軍職，與祠。

translations.literal: In the fifth month Li Xianzhong submitted a strategy for recovery, was stripped of military office, and given a temple commission.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month Li Xianzhong submitted a strategy for recovery, was stripped of military office, and given a temple commission.

sentences.zh: 六月，迪功郎王廷珪編管辰州，以作詩送胡銓也。

translations.literal: In the sixth month Credentialed Gentleman Wang Tinggui was placed under supervised exile at Chenzhou for composing a poem to send off Hu Quan.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month Credentialed Gentleman Wang Tinggui was placed under supervised exile at Chenzhou for composing a poem to send off Hu Quan.

sentences.zh: 閏八月，福州言民采竹實萬斛以濟饑。

translations.literal: In the intercalary eighth month Fuzhou reported that the people had gathered ten thousand hu of bamboo seeds to relieve famine.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary eighth month Fuzhou reported that the people had gathered ten thousand hu of bamboo seeds to relieve famine.

sentences.zh: 十一月，胡銓自新州移貶吉陽軍，以作頌謗訕也。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month Hu Quan was transferred from Xinzhou and demoted to Jiyang Army for composing a laudatory piece containing slander.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month Hu Quan was transferred from Xinzhou and demoted to Jiyang Army for composing a laudatory piece containing slander.

sentences.zh: 十九年，帝命繪檜像，自為贊。

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year the emperor ordered Hui's portrait painted and wrote the encomium himself.
translations.idiomatic: In the nineteenth year the emperor ordered Hui's portrait painted and wrote the encomium himself.

sentences.zh: 是歲，湖、廣、江西、建康府皆言甘露降，諸郡奏獄空。

translations.literal: That year Hu, Guang, Jiangxi, and Jiankang Prefecture all reported that sweet dew had fallen, and various prefectures memorialized that their prisons were empty.
translations.idiomatic: That year Hu, Guang, Jiangxi, and Jiankang Prefecture all reported that sweet dew had fallen, and various prefectures memorialized that their prisons were empty.

sentences.zh: 帝嘗語檜曰：「自今有奏獄空者，當令監司驗實。

translations.literal: The emperor once said to Hui: "From now on, when empty prisons are memorialized, the supervisory commissioners should be ordered to verify the facts.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor once told Hui, "From now on, when empty prisons are memorialized, the supervisory commissioners should verify the facts.

sentences.zh: 果妄誕，即按治，仍命御史台察之。

translations.literal: If it is truly false and deceitful, investigate and punish at once, and still order the Censorate to inspect it.
translations.idiomatic: If it is truly false and deceitful, investigate and punish at once, and order the Censorate to inspect it.

sentences.zh: 苟不懲戒，則奏甘露瑞芝之類，崇虛飾誕，無所不至。」

translations.literal: If not punished and warned, then memorials of sweet dew, auspicious fungus, and the like—exalting the empty and embellishing deceit—will know no bounds."
translations.idiomatic: If not punished and warned, memorials of sweet dew, auspicious fungus, and the like—exalting the empty and embellishing deceit—will know no bounds."

sentences.zh: 帝雖眷檜，而不可蔽欺也如此。

translations.literal: Although the emperor favored Hui, he could not be deceived in this way.
translations.idiomatic: Although the emperor favored Hui, he could not be deceived in this way.

sentences.zh: 十二月，禁私作野史，許人告。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month private composition of unofficial histories was banned and people were permitted to inform.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month private composition of unofficial histories was banned and people were permitted to inform.

sentences.zh: 二十年正月，檜趨朝，殿司小校施全刺檜不中，磔於市。

translations.literal: In the first month of the twentieth year, as Hui hurried to court, Palace Guard corporal Shi Quan stabbed at Hui but missed. He was dismembered in the market.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the twentieth year, as Hui hurried to court, Palace Guard corporal Shi Quan stabbed at Hui but missed; he was dismembered in the market.

sentences.zh: 自是每出，列五十兵持長梃以自衛。

translations.literal: From this time, whenever he went out, fifty soldiers bearing long staves were arrayed to guard him.
translations.idiomatic: From this time, whenever he went out, fifty soldiers bearing long staves were arrayed to guard him.

sentences.zh: 是月，曹泳告李光子孟堅省記光所作私史，獄成，光竄已久，詔永不檢舉；

translations.literal: That month Cao Yong reported that Li Guang's son Mengjian had memorized a private history written by Guang. The case was concluded. Guang had long been exiled, and an edict declared he would never be reported for release;
translations.idiomatic: That month Cao Yong reported that Li Guang's son Mengjian had memorized a private history written by Guang; the case was concluded—Guang had long been exiled, and an edict declared he would never be reported for release;

sentences.zh: 孟堅編置峽州；

translations.literal: Mengjian was assigned to supervised exile at Xizhou;
translations.idiomatic: Mengjian was assigned to supervised exile at Xizhou;

sentences.zh: 朝士連坐者八人，皆落職貶秩；

translations.literal: eight court officials implicated by association were all stripped of office and demoted in rank;
translations.idiomatic: eight court officials implicated by association were all stripped of office and demoted in rank;

sentences.zh: 胡寅竄新州。

translations.literal: Hu Yin was exiled to Xinzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Hu Yin was exiled to Xinzhou.

sentences.zh: 泳由是驟用。

translations.literal: Yong was thereby suddenly promoted to use.
translations.idiomatic: Yong was thereby suddenly promoted.

sentences.zh: 五月，秘書少監湯思退奏以檜存趙氏本末付史館。

translations.literal: In the fifth month Deputy Director of the Secretariat Tang Situi memorialized to deliver to the Historiography Office Hui's account of how the Zhao house was preserved.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month Deputy Director of the Secretariat Tang Situi memorialized to deliver to the Historiography Office Hui's account of how the Zhao house was preserved.

sentences.zh: 六月，熺加少保。

translations.literal: In the sixth month Xi was made Junior Preceptor.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month Xi was made Junior Preceptor.

sentences.zh: 鄭煒告其鄉人福建安撫司機宜吳元美作《夏二子傳》，指蚊、蠅也；

translations.literal: Zheng Wei reported that his fellow townsman Wu Yuanmei, a staff officer of the Fujian Pacification Commission, had written Biography of the Two Sons of Summer, referring to mosquitoes and flies;
translations.idiomatic: Zheng Wei reported that his fellow townsman Wu Yuanmei, a staff officer of the Fujian Pacification Commission, had written Biography of the Two Sons of Summer, referring to mosquitoes and flies;

sentences.zh: 家有潛光亭、商隱堂，以亭號潛光，有心于党李，堂名商隱，無意于事秦。

translations.literal: his home had a Hidden Light Pavilion and a Shang Yin Hall—the pavilion named Hidden Light showed a heart attached to the Li faction, and the hall named Shang Yin showed no intent to serve Qin.
translations.idiomatic: his home had a Hidden Light Pavilion and a Shang Yin Hall—the pavilion named Hidden Light showed a heart attached to the Li faction, and the hall named Shang Yin showed no intent to serve Qin.

sentences.zh: 故檜尤惡之。

translations.literal: Therefore Hui especially hated him.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore Hui especially hated him.

sentences.zh: 編管右迪功郎安誠、布衣汪大圭，斬有蔭人惠俊、進義副尉劉允中，黥徑山僧清言，皆以訕謗也。

translations.literal: Right Credentialed Gentleman An Cheng and commoner Wang Dagui were placed under supervised exile; the hereditary beneficiary Hui Jun and Advance Righteousness Vice Warrant Officer Liu Yunzhong were executed; the Jingshan monk Qingyan was tattooed—all for slander.
translations.idiomatic: Right Credentialed Gentleman An Cheng and commoner Wang Dagui were placed under supervised exile; the hereditary beneficiary Hui Jun and Advance Righteousness Vice Warrant Officer Liu Yunzhong were executed; the Jingshan monk Qingyan was tattooed—all for slander.

sentences.zh: 時檜疾愈，朝參許肩輿，二孫扶掖，仍免拜。

translations.literal: At the time Hui's illness had improved. He was permitted a sedan chair at court attendance, supported by two grandsons, and still exempted from bowing.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Hui's illness had improved; he was permitted a sedan chair at court attendance, supported by two grandsons, and still exempted from bowing.

sentences.zh: 二十一年，朝散郎王揚英上書薦熺爲相，檜奏揚英知泰州。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year Palace Attendant Wang Yangying submitted a memorial recommending Xi as chief minister. Hui memorialized to appoint Yangying Prefect of Taizhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-first year Palace Attendant Wang Yangying submitted a memorial recommending Xi as chief minister; Hui memorialized to appoint Yangying Prefect of Taizhou.

sentences.zh: 二十二年，又興王庶二子之奇之荀、葉三省、楊煒、袁敏求四大獄，皆坐謗訕。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year four great cases were opened against Wang Shu's two sons Zhiqi and Zhi, Ye Sansheng, Yang Wei, and Yuan Minqiu—all punished for slander.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-second year four great cases were opened against Wang Shu's two sons Zhiqi and Zhi, Ye Sansheng, Yang Wei, and Yuan Minqiu—all punished for slander.

sentences.zh: 煒又以嘗登李光、蕭振之門，言時事也。

translations.literal: Wei was also punished because he had once entered the households of Li Guang and Xiao Zhen and spoke on current affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Wei was also punished because he had once entered the households of Li Guang and Xiao Zhen and spoke on current affairs.

sentences.zh: 於是光永不檢舉，振貶池州。

translations.literal: Thereupon Guang was never to be reported for release, and Zhen was demoted to Chizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon Guang was never to be reported for release, and Zhen was demoted to Chizhou.

sentences.zh: 二十三年，檜請下臺州于謝伋家取綦崈禮所受御筆繳進。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year Hui requested that from Taizhou, at Xie Ji's home, the imperial brush received by Qi Chongli be retrieved and submitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-third year Hui requested that from Taizhou, at Xie Ji's home, the imperial brush received by Qi Chongli be retrieved and submitted.

sentences.zh: 檜初罷相，上有責檜語，欲泯其跡焉，是歲，進士黃友龍坐謗訕，黥配嶺南；

translations.literal: When Hui was first dismissed as chief minister, the emperor had words rebuking Hui, which he wished to erase. That year jinshi Huang Youlong was punished for slander, tattooed, and assigned to Lingnan;
translations.idiomatic: When Hui was first dismissed as chief minister, the emperor had words rebuking Hui, which he wished to erase; that year jinshi Huang Youlong was punished for slander, tattooed, and assigned to Lingnan;

sentences.zh: 內侍裴詠坐指斥，編管瓊州。

translations.literal: eunuch Pei Yong was punished for pointing and reproaching, and assigned to supervised exile at Qiongzhou.
translations.idiomatic: eunuch Pei Yong was punished for pointing and reproaching, and assigned to supervised exile at Qiongzhou.

sentences.zh: 二十四年二月，楊炬以弟煒舊累死賓州，炬編管邕州。

translations.literal: In the second month of the twenty-fourth year Yang Ju, because his younger brother Wei had died of overwork at Binzhou on an old case, was assigned to supervised exile at Yongzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the twenty-fourth year Yang Ju, because his younger brother Wei had died of overwork at Binzhou on an old case, was assigned to supervised exile at Yongzhou.

sentences.zh: 何兌訟其師馬伸發端上金人書乞存趙氏，為分檜功，兌編管英州。

translations.literal: He Dui sued, saying his teacher Ma Shen had been the first to submit the Jurchen letter asking to preserve the Zhao house, dividing credit with Hui. Dui was assigned to supervised exile at Yingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: He Dui sued, saying his teacher Ma Shen had been the first to submit the Jurchen letter asking to preserve the Zhao house, dividing credit with Hui; Dui was assigned to supervised exile at Yingzhou.

sentences.zh: 三月，檜孫敷文閣待制塤試進士舉，省殿試皆為第一，檜從子焞、焴、姻党周夤，沈興傑皆登上第，士論為之不平。

translations.literal: In the third month Hui's grandson Kun, Huaiwen Pavilion Attendant-Drafter, took the jinshi examination and ranked first in both the provincial and palace examinations. Hui's nephews Chun and Yu, his affinal kin Zhou Yin, and Shen Xingjie all passed the top tier. Scholar-official opinion was aggrieved.
